<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>State-level welfare and hiring:</strong> The Delhi cabinet has approved the ‘DURGA’ scheme to provide 1,300 e-autos for women and transgender persons, while the Suvendu cabinet has authorized the recruitment of 1.5 lakh government positions.</li>
  <li><strong>Digital ID policy:</strong> New biometric rules for subsidies have effectively rendered Aadhaar mandatory for accessing government welfare, sparking discussions on digital governance.</li>
</ul>
